semantics.source_rule: Each causality edge has exact source identity.
semantics.target_rule: Each edge has exact target identity.
semantics.type_rule: Causation and correlation are distinct edge semantics.
semantics.provenance_rule: Edge records originating rule/Trigger/operation where applicable.
semantics.graph_rule: Causal graph is built only from explicit edges.
semantics.ownership_rule: Causality edge does not transfer semantic ownership between nodes.

invariants.rule: Event, Trigger, Runner and resulting Event are separate explicit identities connected only by declared causality edges; matching or adjacency never implies execution.

references.purpose: Trigger matches are explicit causal nodes/edges.
